The National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA), in collaboration with Border Health Services and the Ministry of National Health Services, has introduced an easy procedure for Pakistani Hajj and Umrah pilgrims to obtain vaccination cards in line with the requirements set by the Saudi government. Under the new procedure, pilgrims can obtain their NADRA vaccination cards through three simple steps. They can complete biometric verification

Infrastructure Realities and Policy Constraints

According to technical filings and disclosures reviewed by this desk, capital expenditure allocations for dense wavelength fiber lines and localized compute nodes have accelerated.
